ValidationRule.description: Requires Out of Target Detail when Unqualified Reason is Out of target.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Unqualified"), ISPICKVAL(Unqualified_Reason__c, "Out of target"), TEXT(Out_of_target_detail__c) = "" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify the out of target detail.
